title: Translation
subtitle: Help make these frameworks readable outside English
heroIntro: The site exists in English, Swedish, and Japanese, with English far ahead of the other two. Adding a language, or filling gaps in an existing one, is among the most useful things anyone can do here — and partial translations are genuinely welcome.

languageFallback.title: Content in your language coming soon
languageFallback.text: This guide is currently displayed in English until translation is complete.

githubDescription: Browse existing translations, open issues, and submit pull requests.
getStartedText: Interface files are short and self-contained, which makes them a good first contribution. Framework overviews are the highest value per hour. Either way, a section at a time is a normal way to work.
